_om: English translation of handelser.json. Texts only; the numbers stand in the Swedish file. The events are matched by their ids.

text: The walls draw breath. To the {horn} stone grinds on stone, and where there was a wall there is now an opening.
har: The wall beside you slides aside with a long breath. There is an opening there now.

text: Somewhere to the {horn} a wall cracks, and coins rattle down onto a floor.
har: The wall cracks beside you, and coins rattle down around your feet.

text: The sun finds a way through the slits. A pale light falls through the whole tower, and the darkness draws back for a while.
To the {horn} something dry and thin rustles. The serpent has shed its skin.
har: A dry, translucent skin slides down the wall beside you.

text: To the {horn} a ceiling caves in with a roar. No one can get into that room for a while.
har: The ceiling caves in on you! The floor gives way, and you fall into the vaults.

text: To the {horn}, where someone died, something of white bone rises.
har: Where someone died, something of white bone rises right beside you.

text: A bell strikes somewhere deep in the tower, a single stroke. The light outside turns redder.
har: At the stroke of the bell the serpent's breathing stops short. The next handful you take will not wake it.
